messages:
Maria Chen: bumped queue-policy draft to add prefetch window for expected tool calls, test in staging
Sam Lee: nice. did you change token_budget_target too?
Maria Chen: not yet. baseline: token_budget_target=20, batch_timeout_ms=12
Sam Lee: staging perf after queue tweak: p50 18ms -> 16ms, p99 220ms -> 270ms :/  throughput up 3%
Jing Patel: looks like the p99 regression aligns with toolcall spikes. when the decoder sees a tool pause, kernel swaps and KV eviction happen
Nate Ortiz: repro steps I used:
```
./bench --concurrency 64 --seq 512 --mode=structured --toolcall_prob=0.12
```
observed idle gaps ~28-40ms per shard
Karim Ahmed: that idle gap + kernel swap explains p99. two ideas: pre-seal batches when upcoming toolcalls likely, or bump token_budget_target so batches finish before pause
Maria Chen: quick metric from profiler: stop-token scan cost ~0.55us/token; when structured output enabled stop checks run extra loop
Sam Lee: we should avoid scanning entire output for stop tokens on every token. Could do incremental suffix-check with small rolling hash
Jing Patel: also KV cache churn: when a toolcall returns a short payload we reattach and kernel chooses a smaller matmul kernel with worse throughput due to seq mismatch
Nate Ortiz: I can craft an A/B that sets token_budget_target=30 and batch_timeout_ms=8 on half of shards overnight
Karim Ahmed: add kernel_selection_hint tag for these runs so we can see which kernel chosen for fragment vs contiguous batches
infra-bot: deploy staging/2026-03-17-rc3 succeeded in us-west-2 :white_check_mark:
Maria Chen: rolled rc3 back on staging after repro; created issue INF-1298
Sam Lee: proposal: new heuristic "tool_affinity": if a request has toolcall probability > 0.1, route to small-window batches and prefetch KV entries; else normal batching
Jing Patel: +1. also add metric tool_pause_duration to trace to correlate with batch fragmentation
Maria Chen: will draft a PR with flags: --tool_affinity_threshold, --token_budget_target_override, and a kernel_selection_hint metric
Nate Ortiz: I'll run long-run tomorrow and add perf counters: decode_idle_ms, kernel_swap_count, kv_eviction_count
Karim Ahmed: FYI kernel_picker currently uses seq_histogram buckets size=64. maybe reduce to 32 for better continuity
Sam Lee: packing these into a concise test plan:
- A: baseline
- B: token_budget_target=30, batch_timeout_ms=8
- C: token_budget_target=20, tool_affinity=1, kernel_hint
collect: p50/p95/p99, kernel_swap_count, kv_eviction_count, decode_idle_ms
Maria Chen: thanks. assigning INF-1298 to me. will update thread when PR lands
Sam Lee: ping me on the PR, will review
Jing Patel: adding a tiny patch that delays stop-token scanning until after toolcall return when toolcall expected — may reduce unnecessary checks
Maria Chen: ok merging small stop-scan guard to feature branch
Nate Ortiz: running soak now, will report tomorrow morning
Sam Lee: moving this to triage meeting in 15m
